resources.string: Monitor and control your Viessmann gas boiler with the official Viessmann API.
A Viessmann boiler connected to the internet and set up in the ViCare app
A free Viessmann developer account. Setting it up takes about 5 minutes.
Every user registers their own API client. Your data goes straight from Viessmann to this phone.
I already have a client ID
Explore the app with a sample Vitodens boiler and a week of history. No account is needed and nothing is sent to Viessmann. Leave the demo any time under More → Exit demo.
Demo with sample data, not a real boiler
Sign in with your ViCare account: the same e-mail and password as in the ViCare app.
Accept the terms of use if asked. The free Basic plan is enough.
Come back to this app when you are signed in to the portal.
In the portal, open Clients and add a new client.
Redirect URI: copy it exactly, with two slashes after the colon:
Save the client. The portal shows its Client ID: copy it.
Paste the client ID of the client you just created.
This does not look like a client ID. It is a long string of letters and digits without spaces.
A new client can take a few minutes before Viessmann accepts sign-ins with it.
Sign in with your ViCare account. Viessmann then asks you to allow access for your client.
Invalid redirection URI or page not found after logging in: the redirect URI of your client must be exactly %1$s
Invalid client: check the client ID, or wait a few minutes after creating the client.
A reCAPTCHA that never finishes: turn reCAPTCHA off for your client in the portal.
Your session expired. Please sign in again.
Sign-in was cancelled or the browser did not return to the app.
Reads your account, installations, gateways, devices and all their features once, and stores the raw responses on this phone. Each run costs about 8 API calls.
Mask IDs, serial numbers and personal data in the export
Not run again: a discovery is already running or finished less than a minute ago.
Not available in the Basic plan (403).
Rate limit reached (429). Discovery stopped to protect your API budget.
